onset.Description: Onset of the screen event relative to the first iEEG sample

Levels.word: A Dutch word (IFA corpus, extended with the numbers one to ten) shown for about 2 s; the participant read it aloud once
Levels.fixation: Fixation cross shown for about 1 s after each word

value.Description: The word shown on screen ('+' for fixation). Numbers appear as digits in the source markers.

sample.Description: Index of the iEEG sample at event onset (0-based, 1024 Hz)
